angularPrior.basis: predefined prior; no FIRMS pass, held-out error or fitted value contributes. Not a confidence interval; not a measured historical error.
angularPrior.todayAgreementNote: Agreement of printed X with the catalog azimuth today (< 0.3 deg) does not prove the 2025 pose; the prior is not derived from it.

assumptions: Printed pan X is ASSUMED to be the true-north azimuth of the image centre in 2025. This is an assumption: it is not fitted to FIRMS and not verified for 2025.
Printed X comes from agent-read frames and is not operator-reviewed; poses are never transferred (each pose uses only its own X).
Today (2026-10-17) printed X mod 360 agreed with the public catalog azimuth within 0.28 and 0.16 deg and the printed clock matched PDT; this does not prove the 2025 pose, clock, zoom mapping or FOV.
Horizontal FOV = 65.1 deg at zoom 1 (catalog value, unverified) scaled by focal length for the printed zoom (zoom reading unverified). Not fitted.
Camera positions are candidates (same as fit.py); CAL FIRE incident point is not used. PDT is a hypothesis for frame/pass matching only.

The angular band is a predefined prior (3.0 deg half-width) with sensitivity [0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 10.0] deg; it is not a confidence interval and not a measured historical error. FIRMS never selects it.
FIRMS passes are a compatibility check only: detections form several groups, the pass centroid is not an observed smoke base, and temporal agreement is not independent physical truth.
Cross-track metres = satellite range x sin(angle): compatibility with a satellite direction, not 2D localization nor absolute geographic error.

contrast.meaning: satellite-fitted yaw (fit.py) shown as printedMinusFit only; never an input

limitations: One pose per camera cannot validate a motion/zoom transfer function.
A current clock match does not prove historical camera configuration.
Public catalog azimuth is an external consistency check, not a surveyed ground-truth calibration.

description: Primary azimuth model: historical printed pan X assumed to be the pose azimuth. Nothing fitted to FIRMS. Contrast with calibration.json is a separate column.

frozenSplit.rule: No pass is a fit pass: every pass of a pose is check-only (heldOut). PDT assumed for matching. Pass sources/epochs are those of fit.py.

limitations: The azimuth is an assumption (historical printed X); no FIRMS fit or held-out validation supports it.
Compatibility with FIRMS is angular / cross-track at satellite range, not geographic error; sectors can be many degrees wide.
PDT is not verified; a 2026 clock/azimuth agreement does not carry to 2025.
G2 and G3 have no FIRMS pass in their windows (not-observed-in-pose-window): their parameters are assumptions without any satellite check.

errors.note: check only: no pass is a fit pass; heldOut lists every pose pass that had a visible observation within 5 min
errors.unit: degrees (azimuth) and metres cross-track at FIRMS range; NOT absolute geographic error

buckrock.assumption: The camera is on the Buck Rock lookout summit. Supported by: the database coordinate and an independent DEM summit search agreeing within ~25 m, and the elevation match. No source states camera mounting.

delilah.assumption: The camera 'Delilah Lookout 2' is mounted on, or at the summit of, the Delilah fire lookout. Not stated by any source consulted; supported only by the elevation match (printed 5151 ft = 1570 m vs 3DEP 1572.1 m at the lookout point) and by the name.
